audit_kind: AOSP source/patch/runtime audit linked to a fresh, source-archived Internet session
compiler_audit_method: Read the original six javac actions using Ninja -t commands; never execute their shell cleanup.
Retain the JDK, language/debug/code-generation flags, annotation processors and source response files.
Redirect class/generated outputs to temporary directories; omit the OnError diagnostic action and cleaned non-source response lists.
Compare all selected outer/nested class names and bytes, ignoring only JAR order and container timestamps.
limitations: Source/bytecode/image checks and measurement-time device hashes are not a signed build attestation or a reproducible full-image rebuild.
The experiment retains selected source/build/public-input bytes and APK hashes, not every toolchain dependency byte.
Single-device, fixed-order Internet observations do not establish deployment-scale performance or privileged rollback resistance.
scope: Recorded AOSP runtime plus exact archived sources of the fresh experiment drivers
